verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk export or account-exit feature that produces data in open formats. The REST API ("access or manipulate configuration data") is a developer building block a user would have to script against, so it earns no credit. The CSV item is an import ("Import Users from a CSV"), not an export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
